notes: Read the whole `case "exportServer":` block (lines 339-386) end to end: there is no `self.isServerRunning` guard anywhere in it, unlike `applyPaperTemplateToSelectedServer` (AppViewModel+Templates.swift line 301-304) which explicitly refuses while the server is running. **This contradicts this step's own "What" wording**, which named a running-server refusal for export-as-template -- none exists in source for the remote-API export path; recorded here as a wording correction (the same kind P7.1 made for `archiveServerJar` and NeoForge/Forge) rather than characterizing a refusal that isn't there. The jar destination filename comes from the `PaperVersionSidecarManager` sidecar when present (`paper-<mc>-build<build>.jar`, line 353), falling back to the source jar's own filename when there's no sidecar (line 355); `includePlugins` defaults to `true` when the field is omitted (`req.includePlugins ?? true`, line 370), and a missing plugins directory is tolerated via `try?` (line 371), not an error.
